projects.name: MergeSurvivor
projects.summary: The studio's first product: a merge-and-survive game with a deterministic C# core and a thin Unity shell over it.
projects.notes: The game is a separate repository. JARVIS refers to it through repo and ref and owns none of its files: the paths under owns describe what MergeSurvivor holds in ITS repository, not anything here. NoProjectOwnedPathExistsInTheStudioRepository enforces the separation from this side -- once the studio layer lives in its own repository, an Assets/ directory appearing here fails the build. The only studio-owned code that ever reached into the game was the gate machinery under Studio/build that compiled Assets/Core from outside; it stayed with the game when JARVIS was separated. Nothing under Assets ever imported anything from Studio.
